# SC2013: ambiguous-dependency

## Meaning

The compiler emitted this diagnostic for ambiguous dependency. The declaration or generated contract violates a statically checkable SupaCloud rule.

## Fix

Use an explicit local binding or import a single public provider. Re-exporting the same original provider through multiple paths is allowed; distinct origins are ambiguous.

## Reproduction

Place the example below in a focused compiler fixture and assert that `SC2013` is reported with a file location. The fixture must fail before the fix and pass after it.

## Failing Example

```ts
// Expected diagnostic: SC2013
@Module({ name: "a", providers: [{ provide: PORT, useValue: "a" }], exports: [PORT] }) class A {}
@Module({ name: "b", providers: [{ provide: PORT, useValue: "b" }], exports: [PORT] }) class B {}
@Injectable() class Consumer { constructor(@Inject(PORT) readonly port: string) {} }
@Module({ name: "feature", imports: [A, B], providers: [Consumer] }) class Feature {}
```
